# anchor range minimum

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:anchorRangeMin`](gmeow-anchorRangeMin.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/anchorRangeMin>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The anchored range's lower bound. Functional; must not exceed the upper bound (SHACL).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md) -> [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:anchorRangeMin`](gmeow-anchorRangeMin.md) from [`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md) to [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to set the lower bound of a score anchor's range.

### Avoid when

- Avoid more than one (it is functional) and avoid a lower bound above the upper bound (SHACL).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:anchorRangeMin`](gmeow-anchorRangeMin.md) once per [`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md), paired with a [`gmeow:anchorRangeMax`](gmeow-anchorRangeMax.md) it does not exceed.

### Examples

- ex:a1 [`gmeow:anchorRangeMin`](gmeow-anchorRangeMin.md) 0.8.
